name: kqs-supportflow
description: Connects Claude or ChatGPT to your remote workstations, kiosks, servers, or IOT devices in a secure manner using the locally installed SupportFlow Client running on this PC: work on remote PCs, fix issues, apply updates, read their telemetry, and more. Needs the SupportFlow Client (1.5.19 or later) installed and signed in.
keywords: connect any remote workstation, kiosk, signage, or IOT device to Claude or ChatGPT
